limitations: No preprocessor configurations are evaluated; mutually exclusive branches remain present.
Function and call extraction is lexical and can include declarations or macros.
C-family strings include internal, structural, debug, platform, and user-visible text; non-C-family resources are fingerprinted but not parsed as string literals.
Dynamic formats and compositional naming/grammar need dataflow and human review.
Generated English IDs are candidates, not accepted semantic runtime catalog keys.
The scan does not translate text, execute Lua, or establish Rust gameplay parity.
